column4: Sdr. Andre Setiawan is a systematic thinker who tends to follow procedures in both personal and business life.  Proceeding in an orderly, predetermined manner, he/she is precise and attentive to detail.  He/She acts in a highly tactful, diplomatic fashion and rarely antagonizes his/her associates consciously.  He/She is extremely conscientious, He/She painstakingly requires accuracy in work and maintains high standards.  He/She may tend to get bogged down in details, particularly when decisions must be made.  He/She wants standard operating procedures and no sudden changes.
